DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった物について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask about the item you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道で指輪を拾いました。小さいので、この紙で包んで持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙に包んだ拾得指輪を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a ring on the sidewalk. It is small, so I wrapped it in this paper and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in the found ring wrapped in paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらのトレーの上で開いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Could you open the wrapping over this tray?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで開きます。拾った時は石が一つ外れかけていたので、触らないようにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: トレーで開き拾った時の破損状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will open it here. One stone was coming loose when I found it, so I tried not to touch it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unwrap it on the tray and describe its damage when found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態も記録します。拾った場所を、この地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record its condition too. Can you indicate where you found it on this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パン屋の前の、この植え込みの横です。店の中ではなく歩道に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で店舗内と歩道を区別して拾得地点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here, beside these shrubs in front of the bakery. It was on the sidewalk, not inside the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location on the map, distinguishing the sidewalk from inside the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩道の植え込み横ですね。拾った時刻を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Beside the shrubs on the sidewalk, then. What time did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の二時ごろです。いったん紙で包んで、ほかの用事に寄らずこちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得時刻と交番へ直接来た経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around two today. I wrapped it in paper first, then came straight here without stopping for other errands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the finding time and that you came directly to the police box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。届出の手続きをご説明しますので、お名前などをこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will explain the reporting procedure; please put your name and other details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この用紙に書きます。包んだ紙も、指輪が転がらないよう一緒に渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙へ記入し包装紙ごとの受け渡しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write on this form. Can I hand over the wrapping paper with it so the ring does not roll away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in the form and ask to hand it over with the wrapping paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一緒にお預かりします。届けていただきありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the paper too. Thank you for handing it in. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居の届出についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will explain the change-of-address notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけ引っ越して、同居人は今の家に残ります。家に来る郵便を全部転送するのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分だけ転居し同居人の郵便は残したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I am moving; my housemate is staying in our current home. I do not want all the mail coming to the house forwarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are moving and your housemate's mail should stay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居される方のお名前を記入します。今の住所から転居する方は、お一人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Enter the names of the people moving. Are you the only person moving from your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私一人です。この用紙の同居人の名前も書く欄は、転居する人の欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居人数と氏名追加欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, just me. Is this section for adding a housemate's name intended for people who are moving?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State how many are moving and ask what the additional-name section means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは転居する方を追加する欄です。今回残る方は、そこには書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is for adding people who are moving. Do not enter anyone who is staying this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私の名前だけにします。同じ名字なので、下の名前まではっきり書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同姓の同居人と区別して自分だけ記入すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will enter only my name. We have the same surname, so I will clearly write my given name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will enter only yourself, distinguishing yourself from a housemate with the same surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい住所と転送の開始希望日もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Also enter your new address and desired forwarding start date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開始日は来月一日です。その前に出した荷物が今の家へ届く予定なのですが、それは別に確認が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転送開始日を伝え既に送った荷物を別に確認すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The first of next month. A parcel sent before that is scheduled to arrive at our current home; should I check that separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the forwarding start date and ask about separately checking a parcel already sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物の扱いは種類によって異なります。送り主や配送担当へ、到着先をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Parcel handling depends on the type. Please check the destination with the sender or delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 郵便の届出は私一人で書けました。荷物は送り主へ連絡し、今の家で受け取る予定を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人分の届出と荷物の到着先照会を分けて進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have completed the mail notification for just myself. I will contact the parcel sender to confirm that it will be received at our current home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed separately with the one-person notification and checking the parcel destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届出をお預かりします。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the notification. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届け内容の変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your registered details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前の店の住所に、口座の案内が届いていました。店を閉めたので、郵便の送り先を自宅へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉店した店への銀行郵便を自宅へ替えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Account notices were arriving at my former shop's address. I have closed the shop, so I would like bank mail sent to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to redirect bank mail from a closed shop to your home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の登録住所と、郵便の送り先を確認します。お口座は個人名のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the account's registered address and mailing address. Is the account in your personal name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 個人名です。登録した住所は自宅のままですが、郵便は店で受け取っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人口座の登録住所と郵便先の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is. The registered address is still my home, but I was receiving mail at the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the personal account's registered and mailing addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの住所が別だったのですね。届いた封筒をお持ちでしたら、拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the two addresses were different. If you have an envelope that arrived, may I see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒です。先月は店へ届きました。古い店の住所を残さないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧店舗宛ての封筒を示し旧郵便先を変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the envelope. It arrived at the shop last month. I do not want the old shop address left on the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the envelope addressed to the former shop and request changing the old mailing address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更できる項目を担当へ確認します。ほかの口座についても、同じご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the person in charge which details can be changed. Do you want the same for other accounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一つだけです。ほかの口座は自宅へ届いています。変更する口座を通帳で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象を一口座に限定し通帳で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only this one. Mail for the other accounts comes to my home. I will show the account to change in my bankbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the request to one account and indicate it in the bankbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その口座の郵便連絡先として、自宅をご希望ですね。用紙をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You want your home as the mailing contact for that account. I will give you a form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自宅の住所を書きます。登録住所まで変える依頼ではなく、この口座の郵便先の変更でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録住所変更と郵便先変更を区別して依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my home address. Please change this account's mailing address, rather than treating it as a request to change the registered address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish a registered-address change from a mailing-address change in your request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容を引き継ぎます。担当の席へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on those details. Please go to the staff member's desk. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の汁物を作ります。この袋は一回で使い切る量ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の汁物用に商品一袋の量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making soup for two. Is this bag an amount to use up in one go?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much one bag contains for soup for two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中に小袋が十袋入っています。小袋一つに対して、水の量が裏へ書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are ten small packets inside. The water amount for each packet is written on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋に六百ミリリットルですね。私の鍋では半分の量しか作りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小袋の指定水量と作る量の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is 600 milliliters per packet. I will make only half that amount in my pot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the packet's specified water amount and what you will make. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少なめに使う場合は、こちらの粉末の品もあります。分量を量って使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want to use a smaller amount, we also have this powdered product. You can measure the quantity you use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 粉末の方を見ます。この「小さじ一」は、袋に付いているさじ一杯という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 粉末品を選び小さじ表記と付属さじの有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look at the powder. Does “one teaspoon” here mean one spoonful of a spoon included in the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the powder and ask about the teaspoon indication and whether a spoon is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: さじは付いていません。調理用の小さじで量る表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: No spoon is included. It refers to measuring with a cooking teaspoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の計量さじを使います。魚のだしがよいのですが、これは何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手持ち計量さじを使うと伝え原材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use my measuring spoon at home. I would like fish stock; what is in this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use your own measuring spoon and ask about the ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原材料欄には、かつお節と昆布が書いてあります。ほかの材料も、この欄でご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ingredients list mentions bonito flakes and kelp. You can check the other ingredients in this section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を読みました。量を変えやすい、この粉末を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読んで調整しやすい粉末品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the label. I will buy this powder because its quantity is easy to adjust.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the label and choose the powder for easy quantity adjustment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take it to checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇を見ながらお散歩でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you walking around and looking at the flower beds?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩きたいのですが、入口の花の香りが強く感じられました。花壇から離れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花の香りから離れた散歩道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take a walk, but the flowers at the entrance smelled strong to me. Is there a path away from the flower beds?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a walking path away from the flower fragrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 広場の外側の通路なら、花壇から離れられます。水路沿いの道にも花壇はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The path around the outside of the square takes you away from the beds. There are no flower beds along the waterway either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水路沿いへ行きたいです。途中に段差はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水路沿いを選び段差の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like the waterway path. Are there steps along it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the waterway and ask about steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さな橋の手前に段差があります。橋まで行かず、手前の長いベンチで折り返せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a step before the little bridge. You can turn back at the long bench before reaching the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチまで歩いて休みます。帰りにまた入口の花壇の前を通ることになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段差前のベンチを選び帰路の花壇通過を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk to the bench and rest. Will I pass the entrance flower bed again on the way back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the bench before the step and ask whether the return passes the flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチの横から北の門へ出れば、花壇を通りません。北の門はどちらへ続くか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you leave by the north gate from beside the bench, you will avoid the beds. Do you know where the north gate leads?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 北の道は初めてです。駅へ向かう道につながるなら、そちらから帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅方向へつながるなら北門を使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is my first time on the northern path. If it joins the road toward the station, I would like to return that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to use the north gate if it connects toward the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 北の門の外を左へ進むと、駅前通りへ出ます。案内図のここです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Turn left outside the north gate to reach the street in front of the station. It is here on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左へ出る所が分かりました。水路のベンチまで休みながら歩いて、北の門から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内図で帰路を読み水路と北門の行程を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand where to turn left. I will walk with rests to the waterway bench and return through the north gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the return route on the map and decide on the waterway and north gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームへの移動でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble getting to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行鞄と長い傘で手がふさがっています。鞄を持って階段を上るのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘と旅行鞄で手がふさがり階段が難しいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My travel bag and long umbrella occupy both hands. Going up the stairs with the bag looks difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the umbrella and travel bag occupy your hands, making the stairs difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段の左にエスカレーターがありますが、鞄の大きさによっては運びにくいですね。同行の方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an escalator left of the stairs, but the bag may be difficult to carry depending on its size. Is someone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が改札の外にいます。友人に傘を持ってもらえば、手すりを使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者に傘を預け手すりを使う方法を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is outside the gates. If my friend holds the umbrella, I can use the handrail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest giving the umbrella to your companion so you can use the handrail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、まず外で荷物を持ち直すとよさそうです。まだ改札には入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then it would be good to rearrange your belongings outside first. You have not entered the gates yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。傘は友人へ渡してきます。鞄の持ち手は縮めた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札前で傘を渡すと伝え鞄の持ち手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I will give my friend the umbrella. Should I shorten the bag's handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over the umbrella before the gates and ask about the bag handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段で持ち上げるなら、短い持ち手を使ってください。無理な時は係員へお声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you lift it on the stairs, use the short handle. If it is too much, call a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に傘を渡しました。鞄の短い持ち手を使いますが、途中で休める踊り場はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を持ち直したと伝え踊り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have given my friend the umbrella. I will use the short handle; is there a landing where I can rest along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have rearranged your belongings and ask about a landing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 階段の中央にあります。人の流れをふさがない所で立ち止まれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is one in the middle. You can stop somewhere that does not block the flow of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中央で一度休みながら上がります。出発まで余裕があるので、急がず移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中央で休み時間に余裕を持って移動すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go up with one rest in the middle. I have plenty of time before departure, so I will move without rushing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest in the middle and allow enough time to move without rushing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お困りの時はお声を掛けてください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please call us if you have difficulty. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越し後の学校について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a consultation about school after moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが新しい学校へ通う手続きを知りたいです。前の学校から、この封筒をもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入後の就学手続きを知りたいと伝え旧学校の封筒を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to know the procedures for my child to attend a new school. I received this envelope from the previous school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about enrollment after moving and show the previous school's envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 学校の転入相談は教育の担当へご案内します。お子さんは何年生ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will direct transfer inquiries to the education staff. What grade is your child in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小学四年生です。ここへ来る前に、前の学校で在学の書類を受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもの学年と在学書類の所持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Fourth grade of elementary school. Before coming here I received enrollment documents from the previous school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your child's grade and that you have proof of enrollment documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい住所と、通い始めたい日も担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell the staff your new address and when you want your child to start attending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所はこの転入の控えです。来週月曜日から通いたいのですが、先に学校へ電話しておくべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所資料と通学開始希望日を示し学校への連絡順序を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address is on this move-in receipt. We would like to start next Monday; should I call the school first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show address documentation and the desired starting date, then ask when to contact the school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通う学校の確認と連絡の順序を、教育の担当がご案内します。まだ新しい学校には連絡していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The education staff will explain confirming the school and the order of contact. You have not contacted the new school yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、どの学校か決められないので、先に来ました。子どもも今日、一緒に来る必要がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校未連絡の理由を伝え当日の子どもの同行が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I came here first because I cannot determine which school. Did my child need to come with me today too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain why you have not contacted a school and ask whether your child needed to accompany you today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は窓口での相談を進められます。学校での面談など、次にお子さんと来る日を担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can proceed with today's counter consultation. Ask the staff when to next bring your child for a school meeting or similar appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は封筒と住所の控えを持って相談します。学校と面談の日が分かったら、子どもの予定も決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要資料で相談し学校と面談日確定後に子どもの予定を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will consult with the envelope and address receipt. Once I know the school and meeting date, I will arrange my child's schedule too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult using the required documents and arrange your child's schedule once the school and meeting date are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、教育の担当へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the education staff, then. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約のことでお声を掛けていただいたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You called us about your appointment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の予約を来週へ変えたいと思っていましたが、昨日から足の腫れが変わりました。先に話してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約延期の希望と新しい腫れを先に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was thinking of moving tomorrow's appointment to next week, but the swelling in my leg has changed since yesterday. May I tell you about that first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the desire to postpone and the new swelling before changing the appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。日程を動かす前に、変わった点を伺います。どちらの足ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. We will ask about the changes before moving the date. Which leg is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左足です。前は靴を履けましたが、今朝はきつくて入りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状の側と靴が履けなくなった変化を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left. Previously I could put my shoe on, but this morning it was too tight and I could not get it on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the affected side and the change that now prevents you wearing your shoe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今朝の変化ですね。歩く時と座っている時では、どのように感じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: A change this morning, then. How does it feel when walking compared with sitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩くと痛みます。座っている時は痛みが少ないですが、腫れは残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩行時と安静時の痛みと腫れを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It hurts when I walk. Sitting causes less pain, but the swelling remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the pain and swelling while walking and at rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。症状を医師へ伝え、受診の時期を確認します。予約変更の理由も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will tell the doctor and check when you should be seen. May I also ask why you want to change the appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事の予定です。でも、来週まで延ばしてよいかは、自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事が延期理由で受診時期は自分で決められないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Because of work plans. But I cannot judge for myself whether it is all right to wait until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that work is the reason for postponing but you cannot decide the medical timing yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を含めて確認します。まだ明日の予約は変えず、こちらでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check that too. Could you wait here without changing tomorrow's appointment yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。仕事の連絡より先に、受診時期の説明を聞きます。明日の予約は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元予約を残し医学的な受診時期説明を先に聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will hear the advice on when to be seen before contacting work. Please keep tomorrow's appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original appointment and hear medical advice on timing first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 医師へ確認してご案内します。お話しいただきありがとうございました。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check with the doctor and advise you. Thank you for telling us. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買物から戻ったら、自転車がありませんでした。近くに撤去の表示があるので、盗まれたのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車不在と撤去表示があり原因不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I returned from shopping, my bicycle was gone. There is a removal notice nearby, so I do not know whether it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the missing bicycle, nearby removal notice, and uncertainty about the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示には何と書いてありましたか。写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did the notice say? Do you have a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。保管場所と問い合わせ先がありますが、撤去した日は見つけられませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保管先表示の写真と読めなかった撤去日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is a photo. It lists the storage location and contact, but I could not find the removal date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the storage notice and the removal date you could not find. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その問い合わせ先へ、場所と時刻を伝えて撤去の有無を確認できます。置いた場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can give that contact the location and time to check whether it was removed. Do you know where you left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店の入口の右です。今朝十時に置いて、十一時半に戻りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車を置いた場所と不在に気づくまでの時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: To the right of the shop entrance. I left it at ten this morning and returned at eleven thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State where you left the bicycle and the time window before discovering it gone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その間に撤去があったか、まず問い合わせましょう。自転車の特徴も伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us first ask whether a removal took place then. Can you describe the bicycle too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀色で、前のかごに青いひもを付けています。防犯登録の控えも家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色と目印と登録控えの所在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is silver, with a blue cord on the front basket. I also have the theft-prevention registration receipt at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the color, identifying mark and where the registration receipt is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照会して見つからない場合は、その控えなどを持って再度ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the inquiry does not locate it, please bring that receipt and consult us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の保管先へ電話します。確認結果と登録の控えをそろえて、必要なら戻ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管先に照会し未発見なら結果と控えを持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call the storage contact on the notice. I will gather the inquiry result and registration receipt and come back if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to ask the storage location and bring the result and receipt if it is not found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for consulting us. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類をお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending some documents, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒の窓に、宛先ではなく私の住所が出てしまいます。折り直した方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓に差出人住所が出る問題と折り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The window of this envelope shows my address instead of the recipient's. Should I fold the documents differently?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the sender address showing in the window and how to fold the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の配置によっては、折っても宛先が窓へ出ないことがあります。別の封筒へ入れる方法もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Depending on the document layout, folding may still not place the recipient in the window. You could use another envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この書類は折り目が決まっています。普通の封筒を使って、外に宛先を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓なし封筒へ替え外側に宛先を書くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: These documents have fixed fold lines. I will use an ordinary envelope and write the recipient on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to switch to a windowless envelope and write the recipient outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら宛名が隠れる心配はありません。封筒はこちらで購入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you need not worry about the address being hidden. You can buy an envelope here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類を二枚、折ったまま入る大きさを一枚ください。返信用の封筒も中へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類と返信封筒が入る封筒を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: One large enough for two documents still folded, please. I will also put a reply envelope inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an envelope fitting the documents and reply envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この大きさなら入ります。返信用の封筒は、中へ入れる物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: This size will fit. The reply envelope goes inside, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。外側には提出先、内側の返信用には自分の住所を書きます。逆にしないよう並べて見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外側の提出先と返信用の自住所を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will write the submission destination outside and my own address on the reply envelope inside. I will lay them side by side to avoid reversing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the submission destination outside and your own address on the reply envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お書きになったら、発送前に外側の宛先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After writing, please check the outside recipient before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出先が外側に書けました。二枚の書類と返信用封筒を入れたので、これを送ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容品と外側の宛先を確認して発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The submission destination is written outside. I have put the two documents and reply envelope in, so please send this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the contents and outside recipient, then request mailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take it. Thank you. Please take care on your way home.
